mapper.select: SELECT UI_STNG_CD, UI_STNG_NM, UI_STNG_VL, UI_STNG_EXPLN, USE_YN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT FROM web_ui_stng_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY UI_STNG_CD
SELECT UI_STNG_CD, UI_STNG_NM, UI_STNG_VL, UI_STNG_EXPLN, USE_YN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT FROM web_ui_stng_info WHERE UI_STNG_CD = #{_parameter} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE web_ui_stng_info SET UI_STNG_VL = #{uiStngVl}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE UI_STNG_CD = #{uiStngCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE web_user_info SET PSWD_EXPRY_YMD = DATE(TIMESTAMPADD( MONTH, CAST((SELECT UI_STNG_VL FROM web_ui_stng_info WHERE UI_STNG_CD = 'PSWD_CHG_NOTICE_DAY' AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS UNSIGNED), COALESCE(PSWD_CHG_DT, REG_DT))) WHERE USE_YN != 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID, G.COM_CD_GROUP_NM, G.COM_CD_GROUP_EXPLN, G.USE_YN, COUNT(C.COM_CD) AS CODE_NOCS FROM com_cd_group_info G LEFT JOIN com_cd_info C ON C.COM_CD_GROUP_ID = G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID AND C.COM_CD_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE G.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY G.COM_CD_GROUP_ID, G.COM_CD_GROUP_NM, G.COM_CD_GROUP_EXPLN, G.USE_YN ORDER BY G.COM_CD_GROUP_NM

SELECT C.COM_CD_GROUP_ID, C.COM_CD, C.COM_CD_NM, C.COM_CD_EXPLN, C.COM_CD_SEQ, C.COM_CD_USE_YN, C.GW_CD, C.GW_SRC_COL, C.REG_DT, C.MDFCN_DT, W.COLOR_HEX AS EXT1_CN FROM com_cd_info C LEFT JOIN web_cd_color_info W ON W.COM_CD_GROUP_ID=C.COM_CD_GROUP_ID AND W.COM_CD=C.COM_CD WHERE C.COM_CD_GROUP_ID = #{_parameter} ORDER BY C.COM_CD_SEQ, C.COM_CD
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_cd_info WHERE COM_CD_GROUP_ID = #{comCdGroupId} AND COM_CD = #{comCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_cd_info (COM_CD_GROUP_ID, COM_CD, COM_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, COM_CD_SEQ, COM_CD_USE_YN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{comCdGroupId}, #{comCd}, #{comCdNm}, #{comCdExpln}, #{comCdSeq}, #{comCdUseYn}, #{rgtrId})
INSERT INTO web_cd_color_info (COM_CD_GROUP_ID,COM_CD,COLOR_HEX) VALUES (#{comCdGroupId},#{comCd},#{ext1Cn}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE COLOR_HEX=VALUES(COLOR_HEX)
